description: Enriched drop-in for DbtCloudComponent — mid-run per-model monitor, dbt-style job-selection DSL, plus the same manifest-based enrichments as EnrichedDbtProjectComponent (freshness policies, exposures as AssetSpecs, contract asset checks, mesh via external_packages). All opt-in; defaults preserve base DbtCloudComponent behavior.

monitor_runs.label: Monitor Runs
monitor_runs.description: Enable mid-run per-model monitoring. Parses dbt Cloud debug logs during execution to yield per-model Output events as each model completes — instead of waiting for the entire job to finish.

fail_fast.label: Fail Fast
fail_fast.description: Only applies when monitor_runs is True. When True, the dbt Cloud run is cancelled on the first model failure and the Dagster run fails immediately.

poll_interval.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval.description: Seconds between debug log polls when monitor_runs is enabled. Default 5.

mirror_jobs.label: Mirror Jobs Mode
mirror_jobs.description: How to surface each dbt Cloud job in Dagster. `off` (default) = don't mirror. `asset` = emit an observable AssetSpec per Cloud job (kind: dbt_cloud_job) so AutomationConditions can react when the job runs. `job` = emit a Dagster @job that triggers + waits for the Cloud run. `both` = emit both.

job_trigger_defaults.label: Job Trigger Defaults
job_trigger_defaults.description: Trigger overrides sent by every mirrored @job (applies when mirror_jobs is 'job' or 'both'). Common fields: cause, steps_override, git_sha, git_branch, schema_override, threads_override. Any unset field falls back to the Cloud job's configured value.

job_selection_include.label: Job Selection Include
job_selection_include.description: dbt-style selection DSL. Jobs matching any selector are mirrored. Selectors: 'type:deploy', '*_prod', 'id:12345', or bare glob (name-glob shorthand). Space-separated union. Empty/None = mirror everything.

job_selection_exclude.label: Job Selection Exclude
job_selection_exclude.description: Jobs matching this selection are dropped AFTER include. Same selector syntax.

dbt_docs_url.label: dbt Docs URL
dbt_docs_url.description: Base URL of your hosted dbt docs site (or dbt Cloud Explorer URL). Each asset gets a clickable {url}/#!/{resource_type}/{unique_id} link.

manifest_path.label: Manifest Path Override
manifest_path.description: Override the manifest.json path. By default, the component fetches the manifest via workspace.get_manifest() or similar workspace attributes.

emit_exposures_as_assets.label: Emit Exposures as AssetSpecs
emit_exposures_as_assets.description: Emit each dbt exposure as an observable AssetSpec with real deps on upstream models. Kind derived from exposure.type (dashboard/notebook/analysis/ml/application).

derive_freshness_policies.label: Derive Freshness Policies
derive_freshness_policies.description: Attach real FreshnessPolicy to sources (from sources.freshness) and dbt 1.9+ models (from config.freshness.build_after). Honors meta.dagster.freshness_policy override.

emit_contract_checks.label: Emit Contract Asset Checks
emit_contract_checks.description: For models with config.contract.enforced=true, emit per-column AssetCheckSpecs for each declared constraint.

external_packages.label: External Packages (dbt mesh)
external_packages.description: dbt package names to emit as observable stub AssetSpecs. Pair with exclude: 'package:X'.

name: Enriched dbt Cloud Workspace
